version.changelog: Request host is a constant with no override; call_endpoint.js accepts only this platform's documented endpoints; frontmatter declares allowed-tools, env, network host and scripts-only shell; Permissions and scope section.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Naver search wrapper that sends user queries to ScraperSocial and does not show hidden persistence, file modification, or unrelated access.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires SCRAPERSOCIAL_KEY and sends that key plus search queries to api.scrapersocial.com; this is disclosed and proportionate, but users should understand it consumes ScraperSocial credits.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package installation, dependency download, installer script, or remote code retrieval is present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to Node scripts, a fixed API host, documented endpoints, and user-provided query parameters; the Korean-query FAQ is result-quality guidance rather than a security-relevant directive.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected code shows no file writes, no background workers, no scheduled tasks, no tool modification, and no persistence; it only reads environment variables, performs HTTPS requests, and writes output to stdout or stderr.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is public Naver blog, cafe article, local, and shopping search, and the scripts match that purpose by calling four documented ScraperSocial Naver endpoints and printing JSON.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving the skill access to your ScraperSocial API key and sending Naver search queries to ScraperSocial. Monitor credit usage because result counts can consume paid API credits, even though the scripts clamp synchronous limits to 50 results.
llm.findings:
[LP1] expected: The env, network, and shell capabilities are disclosed in SKILL.md metadata and align with the implementation: read SCRAPERSOCIAL_KEY, call the constant ScraperSocial API host, and run local Node scripts. I did not find hidden hosts, arbitrary shell execution, or unrelated environment access beyond the optional timeout variable.
[SQP-3] expected: The Korean-language query guidance is expected for a Korean-market Naver search skill and does not create agentic security risk or override user control.
